description:
Use this when the user wants to know if a job finished: "are my clips ready", "did the edit render". It waits
up to wait_seconds, then returns status, progress, any error and what was made (an import's project_id, the
clip_ids). Long videos take minutes: call again. After an import made with clip_max_hu, job_id becomes the
clip job and note says so.
Not for: cancelling a job or a find_moments result (get_moments). Free and read only.

job_id.description: job_id returned by the tool that started the work

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for the job to finish before answering, 0-45; default 20

name: job_status
title: Job status
